tournament_metadata.title: Master 31-Model Tournament: Romanian Multi-Modal Transit Delay & Connection Reliability (Waves 1 to 4)
tournament_metadata.validation_protocol: 10-Fold Grouped Temporal Cross-Validation (GroupKFold on ISO year_week)
waves: Wave 1 (v1-v6): Foundational Ensembles, Hurdle Chains & Pinball Loss
Wave 2 (v7-v11): Spatiotemporal Weather Lags, Mixture of Experts & Super-Learners
Wave 3 (v12-v21): Task-Decoupled Pruning, Hierarchical Bayes & Cross-Wave Ensembling
Wave 4 (v22-v31): Studentized Z-Scores, Residual Propagation, Deep Residual MLP & Omega Synthesis
anti_leakage_guardrails: GroupKFold temporal week grouping (158 blocks) preventing future-to-past information leakage
Inside-fold target encoding, empirical Bayes shrinkage, and feature preprocessing strictly within train splits
Monotonic physical constraints preventing unphysical partial derivatives
Zero peeking into the untouched Year 2026 holdout set during tuning, feature selection, or weighting
Overfitting gap auditing (|Val_MAE - Train_MAE| < 0.20 min, |Val_AUC - Train_AUC| < 0.05)

overall_grand_omega_champion.note: All-wave synthesis dominating 6 CV metrics (7.947m CV MAE, 0.9909 Missed AUC, 0.7851 Rel AUC, 84.336% Rel Acc, 0.331% ECE)

overall_standalone_champion.note: Deep Residual MLP + Studentized Z-score GBDT hybrid: #1 Test 2026 MAE (8.479m), #1 Test Missed F1 (0.8970), 12.391m Test RMSE
